items.definition:
a type of bacteria that can cause infections
He developed a staph infection after the surgery.

a type of pottery that is impermeable and opaque
She made a beautiful vase out of stoneware.

a specific community or forum on the Reddit website
I found a useful discussion in that subreddit.

a person skilled in tactics
He was known as a brilliant tactician on the battlefield.

a brilliant red pigment
The artist used vermillion to paint the sunset.

a large, fast-swimming predatory fish
The angler caught a large wahoo during his fishing trip.

a climbing shrub with hanging clusters of flowers
The wisteria vine covered the entire side of the old house.

a delivery of supplies or personnel by parachute from an aircraft
The humanitarian organization organized an airdrop of food to the remote village.

a person who exaggerates dangers or problems
Don't be an alarmist; the situation is not that bad.

A delicate flower or a marine invertebrate.
The sea anemone swayed gently with the ocean current.

A beautiful person or thing (informal).
That new car is a real beaut!

The part of a bell tower or steeple in which bells are housed.
The old church belfry was home to a family of owls.

A person who drinks alcohol excessively; a pub.
He's known as a bit of a boozer on weekends.

A prickly shrub, especially a blackberry.
The path was overgrown with brambles.

The trade of a butcher; brutal slaughter.
The old shop was known for its excellent butchery.

Extreme or irrational fear of confined places.
He suffers from severe claustrophobia and avoids elevators.

A session in which information or instructions are imparted or exchanged.
After the mission, the team underwent a thorough debriefing.

A person making a first public appearance, especially in society.
The young debutant was nervous before her first ballet performance.

A person, animal, or plant that is descended from a particular ancestor.
He is a direct descendent of the original settlers.

Lack of bias or partiality; impartiality.
The judge showed complete disinterest in the case, ensuring fairness.

A small tree or shrub with showy white or pink bracts.
The dogwood trees are beautiful when they bloom in spring.

The wife or widow of a duke; a female holder of a ducal title.
The Dutchess attended the charity ball.

A rapid and uncontrolled descent
The stock market went into freefall after the announcement.

The world of organized crime
The police are investigating a series of gangland killings.

a sweet, red syrup
Add a splash of grenadine to give the drink a pink color.

a former British coin worth half a penny
He found an old halfpenny coin in the attic.

a public bathhouse in Islamic countries
We relaxed in the hammam after a long day of sightseeing.

a strong, coarse fabric; a German mercenary soldier
The old sacks were made of hessian.

a V-shaped trough on a long pole, used for carrying bricks or mortar
The bricklayer carried the mortar in a hod.

a person who has an irrational fear of or aversion to homosexuality
The speaker was accused of being a homophobe due to his discriminatory remarks.

a person who is honored
The honoree received a standing ovation for her lifetime achievements.

excited commotion or fuss
There was a lot of hoopla surrounding the celebrity's arrival.

a traditional circle dance, especially in Jewish or Romanian culture
Everyone joined hands to dance the hora at the wedding.

a series of words used as a magic spell or charm
The wizard muttered an ancient incantation to summon the spirit.

a player in baseball who plays in the infield
The infielder made a spectacular diving catch.

the action of initializing something
The system requires a full initialization before it can be used.

the craft or work of a joiner
The intricate joinery of the wooden cabinet was a testament to the craftsman's skill.

A temporary jail or a period of restricted trading.
He spent the night in the lockup after the protest.

An unfortunate incident; a mishap.
Their camping trip turned into a series of misadventures.

A person who hoards wealth and spends as little as possible.
The old miser lived in a dilapidated house despite his vast fortune.

A model or replica of a design or device.
The designer presented a detailed mockup of the new website.

the state of being naked
The artist captured the raw beauty of human nakedness.

a short film about current events
Before the main feature, audiences would watch a newsreel.

a house provided by a church for its parson
The old parsonage stood next to the church, surrounded by a large garden.

a hole or holes made by boring or piercing
The doctor found a small perforation in the patient's eardrum.

a video game genre where the player controls a character to jump between suspended platforms
Super Mario Bros. is a classic example of a platformer game.

a person or animal that defecates; a spoilsport
Don't be a party pooper, let's go out and have some fun!

a common mineral, iron sulfide, also known as fool's gold
The prospector mistook the shiny pyrite for real gold.

the state or quality of being ridiculous or absurd
The sheer ridiculousness of the situation made everyone burst into laughter.

an animal killed by a vehicle on a road
We saw some roadkill on the side of the highway during our trip.

a shrub of the daisy family, common in arid regions of North America
The desert landscape was covered in vast expanses of sagebrush.

a substance used to seal a surface
Apply a waterproof sealant to the cracks before painting.

a noisy eating or drinking sound
He took a loud slurp of his soup.

a sudden burst of sunlight
A beautiful sunburst appeared through the clouds.

a factory or workshop where manual workers are employed at very low wages for long hours and under poor conditions
Activists are campaigning against the use of sweatshops in the garment industry.

the inhabitants of a town
The townsfolk gathered in the square for the festival.

a volatile oil used as a paint thinner or solvent
He cleaned the paintbrushes with turpentine.

a strong, ringing sound; a nasal accent
The guitar string gave a sharp twang when he plucked it.

a list of items or people under special observation
The movie was added to my watchlist for later viewing.

something that wraps around
She wore a stylish wraparound skirt.

a person attached to an embassy or legation
The cultural attache organized the art exhibition.

an official announcement or communication
The government issued a communiqué regarding the peace talks.

a person who conforms to accepted behavior or standards
He was criticized for being a conformist and never questioning authority.

an eccentric or insane person
His idea sounded like something a crackpot would come up with.
